question: Which prime contractors concentrate the most combined dollar and schedule-slip risk across DoD awards with CENTCOM-adjacent place-of-performance and description signals over the last 12 rolling months?

matches.project: 11 - DoD Contract Awards (child of Prep Agent)
matches.note: Existing FY2026 DoD USASpending pull. Wrong window (FY not rolling 12mo) and no CENTCOM adjacency proxy.
Trend rollup on the same base — same window issue.

internal_scan.verdict: The existing DoD Award Detail DS answers ~60% of the ask but is FY-window and lacks the CENTCOM place-of-performance filter. Correct pass: build a new flow (centcom_supplier_risk) that fetches with the CENTCOM country filter and rolling-12mo window, referencing the existing DS as the internal fallback if the API is down.

indicators.name: Top-10 primes' share of total AOR-adjacent dollars
data_required: Award-level Recipient Name, Award Amount, Place of Performance Country Code, Start Date

candidates.source: USASpending.gov spending_by_award with agencies=DoD + country filter
candidates.result: PRIMARY — this is the canonical live feed

indicators.acceptance: ≥5000 rows over 12mo window with country filter applied; Recipient Name non-null on ≥99%

candidates.source: trend_analysis stats layer over Recipient Name

indicators.name: Award count and dollar-weighted avg award size per prime

candidates.source: trend_analysis stats — count + sum + avg per Recipient Name

indicators.name: Sum of open-window dollars per prime

candidates.source: row-level open_window_flag = End Date >= today; sum per prime

indicators.acceptance: End Date populated on ≥95% of rows

indicators.name: Median days_of_performance per prime
indicators.acceptance: Both dates populated on ≥90% of rows

indicators.name: Share of prime's awards with End Date slipping >90d past today
Sub-agency diversity index per prime
indicators.acceptance: Awarding Sub Agency populated on ≥98% of rows

indicators.name: Month-over-month change in top-10 share
data_required: Start Date bucketed to month, per-prime rolling

indicators.name: Award-type-code mix share per prime

candidates.source: USASpending spending_by_award — include Award Type field
candidates.result: GREEN — field is available in the API

indicators.acceptance: Award Type populated on ≥99% of rows

preference_order_rule: INTERNAL (partial) → EXTERNAL (canonical) → DERIVED. The existing DoD Award Detail DS is a partial internal candidate; the canonical answer requires a new external pull with the CENTCOM country filter.
gap_summary: CENTCOM-adjacency is a proxy via Place-of-Performance country codes + description keyword scan. Not a formal combatant-command tag.
